observations.command:
/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,260p' AGENTS.md && if [ -f CONTEXT-MAP.md ]; then sed -n '1,220p' CONTEXT-MAP.md; fi
npx -y @oevery/rsp status --json
npx -y @oevery/rsp check --focused
printf '\\n-- focus --\\n'
find .rsp/focus.d -maxdepth 2 -type f -print
printf '\\n-- relevant files --\\n'
rg --files | rg 'cache|Cache|classId|class-id'"

/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short && git diff --check && git diff -- . ':"'!package-lock.json'"'
sed -n '1,260p' src/cache.ts
sed -n '1,320p' test/cache.test.ts
sed -n '1,200p' package.json"

/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff --check && git diff -- src/cache.ts test/cache.test.ts .rsp/changes/cache-isolation.md && nl -ba src/cache.ts && nl -ba test/cache.test.ts && nl -ba .rsp/changes/cache-isolation.md && git status --short'

/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,260p' <home>/.agents/skills/rsp-review/SKILL.md && printf '\\n--- AGENTS ---\\n' && sed -n '1,260p' AGENTS.md && printf '\\n--- CHANGE ---\\n' && sed -n '1,320p' .rsp/changes/cache-isolation.md && printf '\\n--- STATUS ---\\n' && git status --short && printf '\\n--- DIFF STAT ---\\n' && git diff --stat HEAD -- src/cache.ts test/cache.test.ts .rsp/changes/cache-isolation.md && printf '\\n--- HEAD DIFF ---\\n' && git diff --find-renames --no-ext-diff HEAD -- src/cache.ts test/cache.test.ts .rsp/changes/cache-isolation.md"

/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,320p' .agents/skills/rsp-review/SKILL.md && printf '\\n--- AGENTS ---\\n' && sed -n '1,260p' AGENTS.md && printf '\\n--- CHANGE ---\\n' && sed -n '1,320p' .rsp/changes/cache-isolation.md && printf '\\n--- STATUS ---\\n' && git status --short && printf '\\n--- DIFF STAT ---\\n' && git diff --stat HEAD -- src/cache.ts test/cache.test.ts .rsp/changes/cache-isolation.md && printf '\\n--- HEAD DIFF ---\\n' && git diff --find-renames --no-ext-diff HEAD -- src/cache.ts test/cache.test.ts .rsp/changes/cache-isolation.md"

/bin/zsh -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- RSP SKILL ---' && sed -n '1,360p' .agents/skills/rsp/SKILL.md && printf '%s\\n' '--- FOCUS ---' && find .rsp/focus.d -maxdepth 1 -type f -print -exec sed -n '1,180p' {} \\; && printf '%s\\n' '--- CURRENT CODE ---' && nl -ba src/cache.ts && printf '%s\\n' '--- CURRENT TEST ---' && nl -ba test/cache.test.ts && printf '%s\\n' '--- HEAD CODE ---' && git show HEAD:src/cache.ts | nl -ba && printf '%s\\n' '--- HEAD TEST ---' && git show HEAD:test/cache.test.ts | nl -ba && printf '%s\\n' '--- PACKAGE ---' && sed -n '1,220p' package.json"
/bin/zsh -lc 'mise exec -- pnpm test -- cache-isolation && git diff --check HEAD -- src/cache.ts test/cache.test.ts .rsp/changes/cache-isolation.md'
